observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: on a stage indoors with dark background and floor lighting
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, weighted shifting between feet
observation.footwork: stepping side to side, toe taps, and small weight shifts in place
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held out at chest and shoulder height with fluid wrist and hand movements, framing the face and body
observation.hips_and_torso: hip drops, hip circles, and fluid torso isolations
observation.levels_jumps_turns: occasional turns and spins on the spot
observation.costume_and_props: ornate headdress, embellished bra top, coin or embellished hip belt, patterned long skirt
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details are obscured by long skirt

signature_moments.what: arms extended to the sides with soft wrist undulations while hips pulse
one arm raised high while framing the head and circling hips
hands joined above the head in a prayer-like gesture while stepping in place
